LOAD-BEARING FINDING for the GO-TEST and GO-IO owners and the orchestrator: on go1.27.1, GODEBUG=execwait=2 never fires for a Cmd from exec.CommandContext, the shape GO-IO-01 requires. CommandContext's default Cancel closure refers back to the Cmd, so the finalizer never runs. A custom Cancel that refers to the Cmd was also silent. The same leak with a Cancel that does not refer to the Cmd panicked. Separately, execwait=2 only fires after a GC collects the Cmd before exit, so a short test exits green. As a result, GO-TEST-12's 'leak-freedom checked under GODEBUG=execwait=2' clause, and the SDK commitment built on it, check nothing on the mandated shape. The skill states this blind spot and routes to reading each Start for its Wait. I did not edit any rule text.
